name: Build debug APK (retry)
command:
cat > /tmp/build_apk.sh <<'SCRIPT'
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/cllin/pocket-ledger/android
export JAVA_HOME="$HOME/.local/jdk17"
export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/android-sdk"
export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"
echo "== jniLibs =="
ls -la app/src/main/jniLibs/*/ || { echo "missing .so"; exit 1; }
if [ ! -x gradlew ]; then
  echo "== generating Gradle wrapper =="
  "$HOME/.local/gradle/gradle-8.14.6/bin/gradle" wrapper --gradle-version 8.14.6 --distribution-type bin -q
fi
echo "== assembleDebug =="
./gradlew assembleDebug 2>&1 | tail -45
echo "== APKs =="
find app/build/outputs -name "*.apk" -exec ls -la {} \;
echo "APK BUILD DONE"
SCRIPT
bash /tmp/build_apk.sh 2>&1
